title: Fixed Pivoted Arm and Counterweight Signal Mast
description: One complete newly authored fixed mechanical-arm railway signal appearance. A grounded concrete plinth carries a full tapered mast and projecting upper bored bearing with transverse axle. One complete wide blank blade extends to one side with a short opposite arm. A continuous long external rod joins that short arm to a separate low counterweighted balance lever on its own transverse fulcrum; pins and a terminal grip are complete solids. A full rear ladder with two continuous stiles, individual rungs and mast ties joins the base to the upper mast. Unlike the old two unlit hooded lenses on a simple mast, this whole object has an elevated transverse blade and long low-to-high linkage. Unlike the old low open-frame switchstand, it has no vertical target-disc shaft or terminal turnout eye. No old mesh imported. Three opaque PBR materials, metres, Z up and actual horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One static prop zero scenes. Blank faces, no standard colors, illuminated aspects, lettering or real route meaning. Fixed illustrative roots only; no linked animation, indication, transmission, ladder access, loads, rail installation, compliance or operational safety claim.
